name: How do you handle escalation clauses in multiple offer scenarios?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle escalation clauses in multiple offer scenarios?

acceptedAnswer.text: Escalation clauses automatically increase a buyer's offer price if a higher offer is received, up to a pre-defined cap. When presented with these, your agent will meticulously verify the validity of the competing offer that triggers the escalation. It's essential to understand the maximum potential price and any other terms tied to the clause, as they can sometimes be conditional. Carefully reviewing these clauses helps ensure fairness and transparency for all parties while maximizing the seller's outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Escalation clauses increase an offer if a higher one comes in; your agent verifies the triggering offer and clarifies all terms.
